t: Refactoring with a Digital Ghost: The Tao of the Mulligan
s: This article details a complex software refactoring process, highlighting the symbiotic relationship between a human programmer and an AI assistant. It emphasizes the 'mulligan' concept in version control and introduces the 'AI Shim' as a strategy for incremental, low-risk code migration.
sub: The AI Shim pattern for incremental change
Philosophy of coding and the 'mulligan' concept
Pipulate class extraction and dependency injection
